content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for oxygen sensor testing with voltage measurements and decision paths. The flowchart has 4 numbered columns (1-4) and shows a sequence of diagnostic steps with decision points based on voltage readings.
labels: Read and record diagnostic codes (See page FI-22)
Unshort terminals T and E1 of the service connector. And maintain engine at 2,500 rpm.
Measure voltage between terminals VF and E1.
Measure voltage between terminals DF and E1
Disconnect the water temp. sensor connector and connect resistor with a resistance of 4 - 8 KΩ or another coded water temp. sensor.
Short terminals T and E1 of the service connector.
Warm up the oxygen sensor with the engine at 2,500 rpm for approx. 90 seconds. And maintain engine speed at 2,500 rpm.
Measure voltage between terminals VF and E1.
